children: CARMEL, Ind., Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Syra Health Corp. (OTCQB: SYRA) ("Syra Health" or the "Company"), an integrated healthcare solutions company powering better health outcomes through prevention-focused, accessible, and affordable solutions, announced today that it has been awarded a contract by the Mississippi State Department of Health (MSDH) to provide epidemiology, evaluation, and biostatistics services.

The agreement has an initial term of September 2, 2026 through September 1, 2029, with a not-to-exceed value of $240,000. MSDH may renew the contract for two additional one-year periods on the same terms, for a maximum cumulative term of five years.
Under the contract, Syra Health will support MSDH's public health decision-making and policy development, with services such as:
Population health assessments and health disparity analyses
Geographic Information Systems (GIS) mapping of health data
Systems-of-care evaluations and analyses of grant-required deliverables and measures
Reporting and consultation for MSDH staff and external stakeholders

"Demand for our public health services, including our analytics capabilities, continues to grow," said Greg Alexander, CEO of Syra Health. "We are thrilled to partner with the Mississippi State Department of Health on this engagement, and to serving as a valuable partner, one that earns the opportunity to extend this contract."

Syra Health is an integrated healthcare solutions company serving government and commercial healthcare organizations with innovative solutions designed to improve health outcomes. We specialize in healthcare prevention, expanding access, and delivering affordable solutions. Our healthcare analytics provide proactive, actionable insights and data-driven intelligence, and our HIPAA-compliant, fully accessible, and award-winning digital health solutions enable measurable health outcomes in highly regulated healthcare environments.
